EN.chatbot_error: Sorry, I'm having trouble connecting. Please try again or contact us at ashisutoglobal@ashisuto-global.com.
EN.chatbot_reply_greeting: Hello! 👋 Welcome to Ashisuto. I'm here to help you explore our products and services. What can I assist you with today?
EN.chatbot_reply_dockita: 📄 DocKITA is Ashisuto's flagship document management solution. It helps businesses digitize, organize, and retrieve documents efficiently — reducing paper usage and streamlining workflows. Would you like to know about its features, pricing, or how to get started?
EN.chatbot_reply_dockita_features:
DocKITA offers:
• Smart OCR scanning & indexing
• Secure cloud storage
• Role-based access control
• Audit trails & compliance tools
• Fast full-text search
• Integration with existing ERP/CRM systems

Would you like a demo?
EN.chatbot_reply_cybersecurity: 🔒 Our Cyber Security solutions protect your business from modern threats. We offer endpoint protection, network monitoring, vulnerability assessments, and incident response services. Want to learn more or schedule a security audit?
EN.chatbot_reply_robotics: 🤖 Ashisuto's Robotics solutions bring intelligent automation to your production line. From collaborative robots to fully automated systems, we help reduce costs and improve precision. Interested in a site assessment?
EN.chatbot_reply_ai: 🧠 Our AI Prediction & Optimization services use machine learning to forecast demand, optimize production schedules, and reduce waste. Real-time analytics give your team actionable insights. Would you like to see a use case for your industry?
EN.chatbot_reply_industrial_design: ✏️ Our Industrial Design team delivers end-to-end product design — from concept sketches to prototypes ready for manufacturing. We combine aesthetics with engineering precision. Do you have a project in mind?
EN.chatbot_reply_manufacturing: 🏭 Our Manufacturing Operations solutions help factories go digital — with MES integration, real-time OEE monitoring, predictive maintenance, and lean process tools. Want to discuss how we can improve your production efficiency?
EN.chatbot_reply_digitize: 📂 Our Digitize Records service handles bulk scanning, indexing, and secure storage of your physical documents. We ensure compliance with data protection standards throughout the process. How much volume are you looking to digitize?
EN.chatbot_reply_pricing: 💰 Pricing depends on the solution and scale of your requirements. Our team will prepare a tailored quote for you. You can reach us at ashisutoglobal@ashisuto-global.com or use the Contact page. Would you like me to help you get in touch?
EN.chatbot_reply_contact:
📞 You can reach our team via:
• Email: ashisutoglobal@ashisuto-global.com
• Contact Form: /contact

Our sales team typically replies within 1 business day. Is there anything else I can help with?
EN.chatbot_reply_technical_support: 🛠️ For technical support, please email support@ashisuto-tech.com with a description of your issue. For urgent matters, our team is available during business hours (Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm MYT). Would you like help describing your issue?
EN.chatbot_reply_partners: 🌏 Ashisuto works with trusted overseas distributors including 3drens, Ricoh, and Ziontech. If you're interested in becoming a partner or distributor, please reach out to our sales team. Would you like more information?
EN.chatbot_reply_about: 🏢 Ashisuto is a technology company specializing in document management, cybersecurity, robotics, AI-driven optimization, and industrial solutions. We help businesses across Asia modernize their operations and improve efficiency. Want to learn about a specific product?
EN.chatbot_reply_thanks: You're welcome! 😊 If you have any more questions, feel free to ask. I'm always here to help. Is there anything else you'd like to know?
EN.chatbot_reply_bye: Goodbye! 👋 Thanks for chatting with AshisutoBot. Have a great day, and feel free to come back anytime!
EN.chatbot_reply_demo: 🎯 We'd love to set up a demo for you! Please contact our team at ashisutoglobal@ashisuto-global.com and mention the product you're interested in. A sales representative will arrange a personalized walkthrough.
EN.chatbot_fallback_1: That's a great question! For detailed information, I'd recommend reaching out to our team at ashisutoglobal@ashisuto-global.com. Is there anything else I can help with?
EN.chatbot_fallback_2: I'm not sure I have the exact answer for that, but our sales team would be happy to help. Would you like their contact details?
EN.chatbot_fallback_3: Interesting question! Could you tell me more about what you're looking for? I want to make sure I point you in the right direction.
